name: Gemma 3 4B (vision)
summary: A capable small vision model for descriptions, composition and lighting notes.
details: Google’s Gemma 3 in its 4-billion-parameter form (about 3.3 GB) can look at pictures. A good balance for describing composition, light and subjects on a mainstream graphics card, privately. Runs in Ollama.

capabilities.label: Artistic analysis of composition and light

licence.name: Gemma Terms of Use
licence.summary: Free to use, including commercially, under Google’s terms and prohibited-use policy. Read them before use.

verification.note: Atlas has not run this model.

instructions: Install Ollama from https://ollama.com, then press Install here (or run: ollama pull gemma3:4b).
Atlas can ask your own Ollama to download it (with your approval). Atlas cannot make a language model look at pictures unless the model is a vision model, as this one is.
